installCommand: echo 'Flutter e Dart sao instalados no buildCommand'
buildCommand: curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.47.4-stable.tar.xz -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C /tmp && export PATH=/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH && flutter config --no-analytics && cd frontend && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons
